Intensive Interdisciplinary Graduate Programs
The University of Arizona Department of Materials Science and Engineering provides a range of research-oriented and entrepreneurial-focused graduate programs. MS, MEng and PhD studies extend well into related fields.
Concentrate your studies in MSE research focus areas. Get the training you need to advance your career, develop technology, start your own company or contribute to globally significant research.
Follow links on this page to the UA Graduate College and University of Arizona Online for MSE grad program requirements. Additionally, the MSE Graduate Student Handbook expands on program requirements and expectations.
